v035.i1: Dictation reports the real cause (mic, permission, service) instead of a silent timeout

v030.i1: Voice results now add meal entries and reuse existing foods
v030.i2: Voice input retries once if dictation hangs

v028.i1: Fixed voice and photo buttons not responding

v027.i1: Row action icons appear on hover, or on swipe/long-press on touch

v026.i1: Warns to add an AI API key before using voice or photo features

v025.i1: Food list items have an actions menu for editing or deleting

v024.i1: Meal entries have an actions menu for moving or deleting

v023.i1: Settings organized into tabs with a close button
v023.i2: Meal groups keep your expanded/collapsed choice

v022.i1: Move a logged meal between breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack

v021.i1: Consistent food names in English and Ukrainian
v021.i2: New foods are shared with all users by default

v020.i1: Voice input and photo food recognition (Gemini or OpenAI)

v020.i3: Search and import products from OpenFoodFacts
v020.i5: More reliable AI recognition when the service is busy

v010.i1: Meal logging with calorie and macro targets
v010.i2: Daily summary, food database and profile
